name: Ratio Write
summary: Own 100 shares and sell 2 or more calls against them; one call is covered, the rest are naked. FLAGGED: unlimited upside risk and not permitted at level 3.

legs.strike_rule: both at 0.30-0.40 delta OTM (one covered, one naked)

max_profit: (strike - share basis + total credits) x 100 at the strike
max_loss: UNDEFINED - unlimited above the strike, because the extra short call is uncovered
breakevens: upper: strike + (strike - basis + total credits); lower: basis - total credits

greeks.delta: +40 per unit at entry, turning sharply negative above the strike

when_to_use: Historically used by market makers and high-IV overwriters expecting a pin. FLAGGED: a bad idea for an automated retail account - the uncovered call has unbounded risk and the account is level 3, so the order will be rejected.
entry_rules: BLOCKED: requires Alpaca options level 4 (uncovered calls). The system must hard-reject any order where contracts_sold > floor(shares_held / 100).

If ever run at level 4: uncovered ratio <= 1 extra contract per 100 shares, and the naked portion must be converted to a defined-risk spread by buying a further-OTM call (which turns it into a covered call + call credit spread, level 3).
management_rules: If permitted, close the entire structure at 25% of max profit - the tail is not worth pressing.
Convert to defined risk immediately (buy a higher call) if the underlying rallies more than 1 x ATR(14).
Never roll a losing ratio write up - close it.
exit_rules: Close all short calls by 15:30 ET on expiration day; an assigned naked call creates a SHORT stock position of 100 shares per uncovered contract.
Immediate close if the aggregate short call delta exceeds 1.20 per 100 shares held.
Hard stop at 2x the credit received.
assignment_risk: Severe. Assignment on the uncovered call delivers short shares the account does not hold, creating an unhedged short equity position subject to buy-in and unlimited loss. Exactly the scenario the never-assign rule exists to prevent.
buying_power: Naked call margin (roughly 20% of notional minus OTM amount) on the uncovered portion - level 4 only.
liquidity_needs: n/a - not usable at this approval level.
common_mistakes: Treating the second call as 'mostly covered'; underestimating how fast a gap-up destroys the position.
zero_dte_notes: A 0DTE ratio write is one gap away from a catastrophic short-stock position. Never.
family: Stock/ETF Shares Combined With Options (covered writes, protective hedges, collars, synthetics, repairs, conversions)
blocked_because: needs Alpaca options level 4; this account is level 3. Alpaca rejects it with 'account not eligible to trade uncovered option contracts'. Raising the level is an Alpaca approval, not a code change.
